recommendation_summary: Act now: keep the working folder for drafts, and add a separate Released location that only reviewers can write to, with versioning and at least seven years of retention or legal hold. Record approvals through a login-required form that logs the approver account and timestamp. On approval, freeze a PDF with its SHA-256 hash in the approval record, and block self-approval through reviewer-only release plus an author-versus-approver check. The agent offers to write the hash/log script and self-approval check. It asks which platform is used and whether reviewers also author documents. It advises telling the customer which controls are interim if the setup is incomplete, rather than presenting initials as compliant.
note: The reply rejects the initials column and chooses enforceable controls covering identity, time, frozen version, non-author approval and retention, but it has none of the four required record labels.
